doc.title: Contact — Noa Tournoy
doc.desc: Write to Noa Tournoy: noa.tournoy@supinfo.com. LinkedIn and GitHub. Based in Lille, France; joining ADEO as a cybersecurity apprentice in October 2026.
quoi.p: From 1 October 2026 I am a cybersecurity apprentice at ADEO, alongside the engineering programme at SUPINFO. Write for a technical question, a proposal to work together, or simply because one of the pieces stopped you. I answer.
quoi.p2: Email is the surest channel. LinkedIn works too.
